text: 从中国企业改革与发展研究会获悉，《2026中国环境社会治理发展观察报告》正式发布。报告显示，首批强制披露主体实现按期披露全合规，A股上市公司披露数量与质量稳步提升。
text_en: It was learned from the China Enterprise Reform and Development Society that the "2026 China ESG Development Observation Report" was officially released. The report shows that the first batch of mandatory disclosure entities achieved full compliance with disclosure on schedule, and the number and quality of disclosures by A-share listed companies steadily improved.
